At Lam Research, we create equipment that drives technological advancements in the semiconductor industry. Our innovative solutions enable chipmakers to power progress in nearly all aspects of modern life, and it takes each member of our team to make it possible.

Across our organization, our employees come to work and change the world. We take on the toughest challenges with precision and accuracy. We push for the next big semiconductor breakthrough. We lead the way in one of the most critical and fast-moving industries on the planet. And we do it together, with deep connections and limitless collaboration.

The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams achievements. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse culture where everyone s contribution and voice has value. We evaluate and evolve our offerings, so our people receive the support and empowerment to do meaningful things for their lives, careers, and communities.

Because at Lam, we believe that when people are the priority and they re inspired to unleash the power of innovation for a better world together, anything is possible. 1 Test Engineer (all genders) LOCATION: Villach, AT, 9500

REQ ID: 204656

What you'll do

 * Design and prepare test fixtures\equipment and executes the test followed by data evaluation

 * Test set-up and execution for

 ** Components/Devices

 ** Systems/Tools

 * Execution of tests

 * Start-up of test stand

 * Handling of related components

 * Operating various measurement systems

 * Structured diagnostic and problem-solving methods must be used during start-up and LAB testing

 * Apply statistical methods for specification of reliability tests and data evaluation

 * Create test documentation based on our standards and meaningful presentation of results

 * Active cooperation with other colleagues on test stand or tool in our test floors or in our clean room laboratory and handling of acids

 * Forward change requests / improvement suggestions to the developer in charge

Who we're looking for

 * Bachelor's degree or Technical education (Apprenticeship, HTL) in one of the following aeras

 ** Electrical Engineering

 ** Mechanical Engineering

 ** Mechatronic Engineering

 * minimum of 3 years of related experience in one of the technical fields listed above or equivalent work experience.

 * Excellent technical understanding and good problem-solving skills

 * Analytical thinking 

 * Very good oral and written communication skills in English

 * Ability to work independently and focus on detail also with changing priorities

 * A high degree of flexibility and the ability to work under pressure

 * Excellent knowledge of MS Office

 * Structured and organized working style

What we're offering

This position is subject to the https://www.metalltechnischeindustrie.at/fileadmin/content/Dokumente/Kollektivvertrag/KV-2025_2026/FMTI_Mindesgehaltstabelle_2025.pdf in occupation group F. REQ ID: 204419

What you'll do
 * Build, lead, and develop a team of Systems Engineers responsible for system architecture, requirements, integration, interfaces, technical risk management and system-level engineering deliverables of semiconductor wafer-processing equipment with the technical depth and leadership capabilities required to support product development programs
 * Manage team performance, workforce planning, resource allocation, hiring, onboarding, talent development and succession planning
 * Assign Systems Engineering resources to development programs based on program priorities, complexity, technical risk and available competencies
 * Develop engineers' ability to lead complex cross-functional teams and technical discussions, resolve conflicts and make sound system-level decisions
 * Ensure that potential system-level design conflicts and cross-functional issues are identified early and resolved to not impact overall product performance and business objectives
 * Provide oversight for development programs, ensuring mechanical and electrical hardware and tool software work together to meet system

Who we're looking for
 * Bachelor's or Master's degree or PhD in one of the following or a closely related technical discipline, such as Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Mechatronics Engineering
 * 8+ years of relevant engineering experience, including significant experience in complex multidisciplinary product or system development
 * Proven leadership experience as a people manager, team lead with ideally 4-6 years of experience leading and developing engineering teams
 * Strong understanding of product development processes including requirements development, system architecture, interface management, design reviews, technical risk management, verification, validation, reliability, and product release
 * Excellent organizational skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and technical issues simultaneously
 * Ability to work effectively with diverse teams, including internal organizations, customers, suppliers, and external partners
 * Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to make decisions in technically complex and ambiguous situations
 * Excellent oral and written communication skills in English
 * Strong professional presentation and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical issues and recommendations to both engineering teams and senior management
 * High degree of flexibility, accuracy, and ability to operate effectively in a dynamic environment with competing priorities

 * Experience in managing engineering teams within semiconductor equipment or another high-tech industry
 * Experience in resource planning, organizational development, coaching, mentoring and talent management
 * Experience in working with cross-functional teams across several sites
 * Strong business awareness, including understanding of the relationship between system architecture, product performance, reliability, cost, schedule, manufacturability, and serviceability
